lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you see him do it?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: No, honestly, yes or no? Did ya see him do it? Don't lie about it. If ya did, good. If ya didn't, good. Did ya see him do that?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why did you just tell me ya did? Brendan.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why did you lie ta me? Do you know, do you remember that at all?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, then say you don't know. He gave you some money out of her purse, though. That I know. How much?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Brendan, who put that stuff in the burn barrel?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz he told me that he was gonna do that.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did ya see that stuff in the house?
